capture: Sembang with a channel open. The channel list is on the left (a few channels and a DM or two visible, one with an unread badge), the open channel's messages and reply box on the right. Use a window at least 1440 px wide. Do not type or send anything.

Sembang, channel list, click 'Browse channels' at the bottom of the channel list. Capture the open Browse channels dialog showing at least two public channels not yet joined, each with its topic, member count and a Join button. Do not click Join.

Sembang, any open channel. Crop tightly to the message composer at the bottom: the formatting toolbar (Bold, Italic, list, code-fence buttons), the text input with some placeholder or sample text, the attach button and the send button. Nothing to send.

Sembang, an open channel with a message that has replies. Click 'N replies' to open the thread panel on the right. Capture the whole screen: the channel on the left/middle, the thread panel (original message plus replies, and the 'Also send to #channel' checkbox near its reply box) on the right. Do not send a reply.
Sembang, channel list, click 'New message'. Capture the open New message dialog with the list of people to pick from, at least one selected. Do not click Start.

Sembang, an open channel, click the 'Tasks' tab under the channel name. Capture the tab: the 'Add a task…' box, an open section with at least one task showing multiple assignee avatars, a due-date chip and a subtask count badge (e.g. '1/3') if possible, and a completed section. Do not add, complete or click into a task. NOTE (2026-09-28): this replaces an older screenshot of the 'Tasks · N open' sliding panel button — the header is now a persistent tab bar and tasks now show multiple assignees and subtask counts, re-capture to match.

Sembang, an open channel's Tasks tab, click a task row (not its checkbox) to open its detail dialog. Capture the whole dialog: the left side (title, status dropdown, assignees, due date, description, subtasks with at least one shown) and the right side (activity log with a couple of entries, and the comment box with its formatting toolbar visible). Do not change the status, add a comment, or delete anything.

Sembang, an open channel with at least one image and one non-image file previously shared, click the 'Files' tab under the channel name. Capture the tab showing an image thumbnail and a plain file row side by side. Do not click into or download anything.

Sembang, click the search icon at the top of the page and type a word that matches messages in more than one channel. Capture the open Search dialog with at least two results from different channels/DMs, each showing a snippet and which conversation it is from.
